resources.string: All four settings are optional. Choose Supply to enter a value, or clear Supply to remove that field. No value is filled from the catalog.
Enter an exact integer of at least 1. The frozen schema sets no upper limit.
Enter an exact integer of at least 0. The frozen schema sets no relationship to chunk size.
This is your stored declaration, not a check of a service or its access controls. Supplied and unchecked means false; clearing Supply means not supplied.
Enter an integer or clear Supply to remove this field.
Enter a valid exact JSON integer. Commas, fractional values and answer-state words are not accepted.
This input exceeds the existing bounded settings reader. Shorten it before saving.

Private pending-input recovery retains at most 20,000 characters across these controls (some symbols count as two). Larger input is replaced by an unavailable notice, without retaining a prefix. Recovery requires review and never repeats a save.
